summary: FIX: Root-caused to the DELETE write path missing invalidate_redirect_target (keys computed in cache service as redirect:<code>, invalidation belongs in every write path that changes or removes the source row). Restored asyncio.run(cache_service.invalidate_redirect_target(link.code)) in the DELETE handler. TTL stays settings.redirect_cache_ttl_seconds (300s) as the expiration safety net. Added regression suite test_cache_invalidation.py: delete invalidates cache (redirect -> 404), update invalidates cache (redirect -> new URL), second redirect is a cache hit. Full suite green.
evidence: fix: DELETE /links/{id} now invalidates redirect:<code> after row deletion
regression: test_delete_invalidates_cache passed (cached key gone after delete, redirect returns 404)
regression: test_update_invalidates_cache passed (redirect Location switches to new URL immediately)
